chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashem quoted on the authority of his father, on the authority of Abdullah Al-Hassani, on the authority of Abi Ja’far Muhammad ibn Ali Ar-Ridha’ (peace be upon him) who said:
I guarantee for anyone who visits my father (peace be upon him) in Toos, recognizing his rightfulness, Paradise on behalf of God the Highest.

key_terms.طُوس: Toos (a city in Iran, site of Imam Ar-Ridha's shrine)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha's shrine in Toos?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Imam Ali al-Rida (a.s.) guarantees Paradise to those who visit his father, Imam Musa al-Kadhim (a.s.), in Toos with *ma'rifah* (gnostic recognition) of his spiritual status. This emphasizes the Shia concept that visiting the shrines of the Imams is not merely a physical act but a profound spiritual connection that affirms their divine authority (*haqq*). The specific mention of Toos highlights the historical significance of this location as a major center of Imamate reverence in Khurasan.
